matches.rationale: No finding identifies an overgeneralized claim in the Abstract that ACE “consistently improves” all metrics and “boosts robustness” without exception. The closest is pred_id 9, which mischaracterizes the abstract as claiming only selective improvements, and pred_id 7 targets the Conclusion, not the Abstract.

Pred_id 4 highlights an inconsistent primal update in Algorithm 1 that confuses primal–dual steps, directly reflecting the method logic corruption. Pred_id 12 identifies a contradictory duality claim in the (PI)/(DI) formulation, which matches the altered constraint conditions and dual variable definitions that make the theoretical presentation inconsistent.

Pred_id 5 points out a contradiction between Table 2 (left) indicating SO(3) augmentations were used for starred baselines and the text claiming they were omitted, which precisely captures the unfair handicap introduced in the experimental setup.
Pred_id 3 directly notes the conflicting definition of γ as both binary ({0,1}) and continuous ([0,1]), which is the core definitional inconsistency in the Preliminaries section.

No finding identifies artificially adjusted or fabricated validation/test metrics. Pred_id 2 mentions unverifiable numbers in the text relative to Figure 2, but does not point to elevated means, reduced variances, or selective reporting of metrics.
No finding mentions omitted limitations, risks, or ethical considerations in the Conclusion. The predictions do not encompass the ethical integrity omission.

Pred_id 7 describes unwarranted superlatives (“groundbreaking,” “revolutionary,” “unmatched accuracy”) in the Conclusion that are unsupported by evidence, directly matching the injected rhetorical presentation manipulation.
Pred_id 1 identifies a fabricated reference with placeholder author names and missing from the References section, exactly the type of reference fabrication described in the ground truth.

Pred_id 10 reveals that critical implementation details (tuning only learning rates, using 300 points instead of 1024) are buried in the Appendix, undermining reproducibility and comparability. This matches the ground truth’s complaint about missing hyperparameters and ambiguously reported ablations.

No finding addresses the selective omission of ACE underperformance or the glossing over of marginal improvements in experiments. Pred_id 7 mentions mixed performance in the conclusion but not the specific selective reporting in the experimental sections.

No finding points to contradictory assumptions (e.g., unbounded networks under boundedness assumptions, non-Lipschitz activations) in the proofs, or challenges the theoretical soundness of the approximation bounds.

The ground truth describes a contradiction between the textual claim of significant outperformance and noisy visual plots with persisting equivariance errors. Pred_id 6 notes an opposite inconsistency (text understating improvements relative to the table), so it does not match the same issue.

Pred_id 11 observes that Table 4 is missing from the paper; the ground truth concerns manipulated numbers that misleadingly show marginal overhead. The missing table is not the same as falsified parameter/runtime data, even if the absence prevents verification.
